description: Fork of exp198 (LUT + STE diverged at ~2.07). Single change: tph=384 -> tph=4096 to address slow pair coverage. Pairs sampled per layer = tph*nap = 24,576 / 73,536 possible = 33.4% (vs 3.1% at tph=384). LUT params per block grow ~10.7x to 8.39M; total ~98.5M. Other settings (nap=6, n_alt=1, smooth=False, n_sparse=32) unchanged.
